comparison.objective: Tear a shelf-ready tray panel off while preserving its cans.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply a directional peel along perforations while stabilizing loaded packaging.
comparison.success_condition: Panel fully removed, tray nearly unmoved, all twelve cans upright, hands clear and scene still.
comparison.reason: It overlaps in preserving contained rigid objects during manipulation, but tests controlled tearing rather than selective passage through apertures.
